# Affine — current MATH reward run

Dashboard: https://affine.io/

Code: https://github.com/AffineFoundation/affine (main)

## Current verified state — 2026-10-04

Our SN120 validator's new-mechanism weights are active on Finney. Independent
readback at block 9203767 confirmed exactly 19 intended recipients, their
normalized shares and current ownership of every winning UID. Those weights
come from 42 fully audited unique task batches finalized in the UTC hour ending
16:00. The transaction first finalized as an encrypted commitment, then revealed
through the subnet's automatic commit-reveal mechanism. All our validator's
positive weights now go to this mechanism. This is not a statement about other
validators' vectors or a confirmation of individual wallet receipts.
The old burn and equal-registration writers are disabled and inactive; the
legacy validator's suppression guard remains in place. Historical nonpayable
experiments are not converted into reward epochs or repaid.
The hourly writer waits for outstanding epoch audits and final scores before
closing their hour. This expected wait leaves prior weights and the reward cursor
intact; it does not treat unfinalized submissions as a zero-point payout.

with approved source 548effe050db7180a17719b92580f01a70d9a95dd212ba6b7fc175de95e694d3.
Its original signed upload deadline is 02:20:17 UTC. The frozen runtime source is
from public commit f590bce9 plus the pinned original MATH asset. Later housekeeping
updates on main do not change an already signed epoch. Subsequent epochs open
after verification, training and checkpoint publication. This static guide does
not declare a window open: check mining.json and authenticate the signed current
manifest before every attempt. Discovery closes when the controller is absent,
at the original deadline, and during verification/training/evaluation.

The model is Qwen/Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct, 7,615,616,512 parameters, trained in
BF16 across all parameters. The dataset has 7,496 distinct original MATH tasks:
6,746 available for mining and 750 reserved for evaluation. The current diagnostic
uses 32 fixed reserved tasks. The latest completed epoch declined from 21/32
to 20/32 after three additional full-model updates, twelve cumulative. This remains
below an earlier 22/32 diagnostic and does not establish sustained improvement
or performance on a larger independent benchmark. Three optimizer steps remain
configured per nonempty training epoch. Larger DeepMath/NuminaMath tasksets are
not part of the active mining contract.
The current trainer verifies every selected pair but applies gradients to only
three pairs. The qualified full-coverage candidate accumulates every verified
pair across the configured optimizer updates and exports one final checkpoint.
Its signed jobs bind the original post-freeze receipt population and random seed,
including exact original-request recovery. Independent H100 and H200 controls
passed: all five curated pairs contributed, all 339 parameter tensors received
gradients, successor proof replay passed and a changed proof was rejected.
The latest qualified source also preserves arbitrary model text, including null

and separate normal/null-text native controls also passed root review.
The qualified immutable source bundle has now been published to R2 with exact

## How to start mining

Use a coding agent to read this guide and the repository guides, set up your
miner, watch discovery and diagnose failures. Keep watching this document and
GitHub main: fixes and upgrades will continue. Each epoch's signed source and
checkpoint take precedence over an older checkout. Never silently reuse an old
source, upload grant, deadline or model checkpoint.

Admission is open to every current subnet-120 identity with valid signed Affine
Ed25519 activation. There is no operator whitelist. Each epoch snapshots the
eligible identities; later activations enter a subsequent epoch. The signed
current manifest contains the actual eligible identity snapshot. Registration/activation is
separate from public dashboard access. Keep signing keys private.

Start with these concrete guides:
- https://github.com/AffineFoundation/affine/blob/main/docs/MINER_QUICKSTART.md
- https://github.com/AffineFoundation/affine/blob/main/docs/MATH_MINER_BOOTSTRAP.md
- https://github.com/AffineFoundation/affine/blob/main/docs/DISTRIBUTED_GPU_ROLES.md
- https://github.com/AffineFoundation/affine/blob/main/docs/CACHED_SAMPLING.md

Use the exact runtime and hardware profile pinned in the signed manifest.
H200/SM90, CUDA BF16 eager, disabled TF32 and CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
are the qualified profile. Core version pins are torch 2.14.0, transformers
5.14.1 and toploc 0.1.6. A package version alone does not qualify a different
GPU/runtime; follow the full setup/profile instructions. The manifest's numerical
policy is authoritative. Full output probability width is 152,064, distinct from
the tokenizer's 151,665 entries.

Read authority and current_url from https://affine.io/mining.json. Run the signed
source bootstrap using your private activated Ed25519 seed file:

CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8 python -B -m subnet.source_bootstrap \
  --authority "$AFFINE_OPERATOR_AUTHORITY" \
  --current-url "$AFFINE_SIGNED_CURRENT_URL" \
  --source-cache /absolute/private/source-cache \
  --key /absolute/private/miner.key \
  --state /absolute/private/miner-state \
  --env-id affine_math --max-batches 3 --search-budget 24 --once

The authority public key is
3301134b38401196d006a621ac4a772bb4b0e6afa15a7d34a0d1ae5f2c630bcd.
The bootstrap authenticates the signed pointer/manifest, approved source archive
and checkpoint file hashes. It admits the original task snapshot and executes
that signed code. Source approval authorizes execution; it is not a sandbox.
Your agent should monitor new epochs and launch each only once, inspect original
process handles after faults and never restart solely because observation timed
out. Do not share your wallet key, decrypted private upload capability or R2
credentials. Miners need no permanent bucket credentials.

## Batch and reward rules

The signed per-UID submission cap is currently three batches per epoch. It is a
conservative configurable pilot setting, not a measured throughput maximum or
a fundamental protocol limit. Each batch covers one authorized task index on the
approved checkpoint and includes at least one genuine successful and one genuine
unsuccessful rollout (K=1, L=1). Extra rollouts for the same task add no points.
Reserved held-out tasks cannot be mined. An unsuccessful search or grader error
is not a valid negative sample. Low per-UID limits do not prevent someone from
registering multiple identities. Submission limits, audit budgets and reward
penalties are separate settings; future changes are signed before the next epoch.

Miners must use the exact source selected by their signed manifest. Main includes
qualified future fixes; copying individual updated modules into a live signed
runtime does not constitute a valid upgrade. Leave time for proof construction,
compression and upload before the original deadline. The current candidate is
qualified on H200, but successor admission and production activation are pending.
See docs/COVERED_EPOCH_TRAINING.md and docs/CHECKPOINT_READ_HYDRATION.md.

All 90 epoch-seven submissions were frozen. Four original audit jobs failed on
expired checkpoint read links; independently checked replacement jobs completed
against identical frozen input and model hashes. The failed originals remain in
history without miner-fraud penalties. Future-source model read links last seven
days, independently of the original upload deadline. Source hashing, verifier
transport recovery and archive checks retain their complete-byte comparisons.
See docs/TRANSPORT_RECOVERY.md, docs/CHECKPOINT_HASHING.md,
docs/SUBMISSION_RETENTION.md and docs/TRAINING_RETENTION.md.

Include complete context/output tokens, full conditional model log probabilities,
TOPLOC activation fingerprints, native observations/outcomes and the immutable
epoch/task/model/source identities. The current manifest selects the explicit
text-tools-long-kv-v3 cached sampler. A genuine same-task success/failure pair
passed independent H200 replay with exact full probabilities, zero TOPLOC
mismatches and eight tampering rejections before activation. Full teacher-forced
verification remains intact. This verifies target-model computation on submitted
trajectories; it does not cryptographically prove their original sampling seed.

Upload cumulatively to your private single-object epoch capability. Replacements
use the same three slots. Only the final completed in-window upload is frozen;
the deadline is never extended to rescue a worker. Frozen hash-addressed artifacts
and audit history are published for independent inspection.

Cheap bounded structure/quota checks apply to every submission. Expensive audits
are randomly allocated after freeze, with configured budgets, minimum/maximum
checks per submitting identity and escalation after confirmed invalid samples.
Independent verifier nodes claim jobs with leases/retries and authenticate their
reports. Infrastructure faults trigger retries, rather than fraud penalties.
Only fully audited valid task pairs earn points or enter training. Observed
cross-miner duplicate task keys receive zero for all competing miners. Unchecked
duplicate claims remain unresolved and that limitation is recorded.

Adjusted points = unique fully verified task points * 0.5 ** invalid_batches.
Structural failures earn no batch points; they do not currently multiply the
remaining points. Epoch-zero thresholds are disabled in the current policy.
These penalties reduce rewards, never confiscate wallet funds. Exact adjusted
points are summed over epochs finalized in the completed UTC hour, then
normalized across eligible current owners. Settings are signed before mining;
upgrades apply to new epochs, never rewrite closed history.

## System and measurements

Arbos.life runs the validator/controller, authenticated audit queue, single chain
writer, discovery monitor and dashboard. Five independent retained Lium H200
nodes run one test miner, two verifiers, one trainer and one evaluator. R2 holds
signed manifests, frozen batches, reports, scores, checkpoints and history.
Two additional machines remain retained for independent qualification: the H200
with the CUDA-context failure ($3.40/hour) and the alternate H100 ($1.30/hour).
Independent evaluation does not compete with the five live role GPUs. The H100
checks do not yet broaden the approved public-miner hardware profile.
The trainer rechecks selected accepted pairs, performs full-model preference
updates against the fixed input-checkpoint reference and publishes a new immutable
checkpoint. The synchronous next epoch waits for this publication. Configured
steps do not imply that every accepted pair was used in an optimizer update.

The dashboard shows only this current reward run, with exactly two charts and
no historical-run dropdowns: matched held-out math performance over time and
frozen submitted batches per finalized epoch. Submitted counts include rejected
or unchecked batches; tooltips distinguish accepted totals. Scoring finalization
alone does not establish completed training. No invented performance values or
promised improvements are displayed. Five phone viewports and a desktop size
passed browser checks, including touch tooltips and no horizontal overflow.

Audit and architecture details:
- https://github.com/AffineFoundation/affine/blob/main/docs/AUDIT_SAMPLING.md
- https://github.com/AffineFoundation/affine/blob/main/docs/LIVE_REWARDS.md
- https://github.com/AffineFoundation/affine/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

Please test with real miner submissions and report reproducible client, proof,
upload or verification failures. Provide the epoch, approved source/checkpoint,
public UID and sanitized logs. Keep private keys and upload grants out of reports.
